data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorer
data.description: Learn to read and understand four-digit numbers using thousands, hundreds, tens, and ones blocks.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands blocks first, then the hundreds, tens, and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at how many flat hundreds blocks are on the mat.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Check the long rod tens column to find the correct tens digit.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Notice there are no tens rods shown on the mat.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Combine all the values starting from the largest block down to the smallest.
